scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:check-csharp-build-killers && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-duplicate-test-classes && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-unscoped-user-writes && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-db-drift && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-size-budgets && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
